description: Build a valid RFC 5545 .ics calendar file with title, dates, location, description and reminder — imports into Google, Apple and Outlook calendars.

faqs.a: Yes. The file follows the RFC 5545 iCalendar standard, which Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, Outlook and most other apps can import.
faqs.q: Will the .ics file work in Google Calendar?

faqs.a: Check the All-day event box and only the date part is used; times are ignored.
faqs.q: Can I make an all-day event?

faqs.a: Yes, choose a reminder from the dropdown — a VALARM with a DISPLAY action is embedded in the event.
Dates you pick are converted to UTC timestamps (Z suffix), which every calendar app interprets in the viewer's own timezone.
faqs.q: What timezone is the event stored in?

howto: Enter the event title, start and end date/time, location and description.
Optionally pick a reminder — a VALARM is embedded in the file.
Click Download .ics, then open the file to add it to your calendar.
title: Calendar Event Generator
